name: vibedev_rail_plan_directive
content: Planning approach (Discuss — read-only, NO code changes, the PLAN is the deliverable):
- Produce a concrete written plan. Do NOT modify files or stage code proposals.

- Make ONE run_coding_task call with `plan_only: true` (read-only — it stages NO diff and captures your plan as the run output). Call it directly: this task's `plan` tag is set by the server and forces plan mode, so you pass no tag and need no schema check. Do NOT re-run it or start a second planning pass.
- Structure the plan: objective, approach, key decisions, risks/unknowns, and the concrete files/areas to change when it is built.
- As soon as that one call returns the plan, YIELD with it as your completed result (a substantive completed item / artifact) — never an empty yield, and never additional planning turns.

metadata.description: Discuss-mode directive for a `@vibedev #discuss` chat-rail run. Mirrors the cockpit's vibeStudioStore.planDirectiveBlock(). Emitted only for plan runs; a build run gets the server-authoritative vibedev_execution_policy block appended at execution start instead, so the rail never composes an implementation policy of its own.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial `@vibedev #discuss` plan directive, mirroring the cockpit's Discuss block. 2026-10-19: name `plan_only: true` as the argument and say the `plan` task tag is server-set, so a careful model calls the tool instead of hunting for a tag parameter.
